captions.detailed: This 3D model depicts a timber-frame bell cote mounted on a flat grey stone-like rectangular base. The frame consists of two dark brown raked upright posts meeting at a gabled apex topped by a short horizontal ridge beam, with a bottom tie beam connecting the post bases. Hanging from the apex is a bronze-colored conical bell, which contains a small dark clapper suspended inside. The bell is mounted on a revolute joint allowing it to swing, while the internal clapper is attached by a secondary revolute pin to swing independently.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a timber-frame bell cote on a rectangular stone base. The frame should feature two angled upright posts meeting at a gabled apex with a horizontal ridge beam, and a bottom tie beam. Suspend a bronze-colored conical bell from a revolute joint at the apex, and include an internal clapper on a secondary revolute joint.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by first defining materials for the stone base (grey), timber frame (dark brown), bronze bell, and black metal components. The base is created as a flat Box primitive. The frame is constructed from Box primitives for the bottom tie beam, the two angled upright posts (rotated and positioned to form a triangular shape), and a top ridge beam. The bell is modeled as a hollowed conical shape using a loft or cylinder-based construction, attached to a revolute joint at the apex. A small internal clapper is modeled as a cylinder/sphere combination and linked to the bell via a secondary revolute joint.
